definitions.full: H3392. Yerach II. [ יֶ֫רַח ] proper name, masculine 'son' of Joktan, only יָ֑רַךְ Gen 10:26 ( ᵐ5 Ιαραδ , ᵐ5 L Ιεραχ ) = 1Chr 1:20 ( ᵐ5 L Ιαρε ).
